meta.title: Built-in desktop pet (dsh-we-pet-builtin)
meta.description: A controlled derived copy of upstream dsh-pet@0.3.7, bundled as a wallpaper upstream-fork subpackage: host half lib/index.js (desktop transparent window, AI chat, pet packs, multi-instance control surface), browser half lib/client.js (prebuilt derived artifact registered as dsh-we-pet-builtin). Fully identity-isolated from an active dsh-pet install (app.setName / userData / data root $DSH_HOME/dsh-we-pet-builtin are not shared).
